g.title:
$outFile = '.\taxons\col-top-paths.json' $cypher = @" MATCH (n) WITH n ORDER BY n.links DESC LIMIT 200 MATCH path = ()-[:HAS_CHILD*]->(n) RETURN DISTINCT path "@ & java -jar $neo4jQuery @neo4jConnParams $cypher --id-property taxonID --include "scientificName,genericName,scientificNameAuthorship,labelRu,links,descendantsLinks,depth,rank,descendants,image,qid" > $outFile $graph = cat $outFile | fromJson -Depth 9
Add-ColorBasedOnGroup -Objects $graph.nodes -GroupBy rank -TargetPropName fillcolor Add-ImageInfo $graph.nodes $whiteListSubstring = 'gbif,britannica,catalogueoflife,bigenc,inatur,wikip' -split ',' Add-WikidataExternalUrls $graph.nodes $whiteListSubstring
$dotNodes = $graph.nodes | % {Get-DotNodeTaxon $_} | % {Get-DotNode $_ id} $dotEdges = $graph.edges | % {Get-DotEdge $_ source target}
$svg = ,"digraph { "+$dotNodes+$dotEdges+"}" | dot -Grankdir=TB '-Gnodesep=0.1' '-Ecolor=green:red;0.25:blue' -Gdpi=27 -Tsvg | Join-String -sep "`n" $graph.nodes | ? imgInfo | % {$svg = svgMergeImageUrl $svg $_.id $_.imgInfo.thumb} $svg = $svg -replace 'transform="scale\(.*?\)','transform="scale(1 1)' $svg = svgAddDescription $svg (gcb -raw) $svg > delme.svg; start .\delme.svg
